instruction: A classic metal sewing machine: a curved cast-iron arm and body on a flat rectangular base plate, a large handwheel on the right side, a needle arm and presser foot at the front-left, a spool pin on top, and moderate wear around the controls. Black enamel with gold accents.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a classic metal sewing machine.
